subject.title: feat(clients): session groups, batch actions, inspector, and worktree-aware creation for native chat

question: Should this protected native-chat expansion land after real macOS behavior proof confirms the intended gateway compatibility and destructive batch-action flows?
rationale: The branch is a broad user-facing native-client feature expansion with persisted session effects; tests and asserted builds do not substitute for visible runtime proof, and the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Request focused native proof
options.body: Require a redacted macOS recording or terminal/runtime transcript covering group creation or rename, a batch-action partial failure, and worktree session creation against the supported gateway.

options.title: Sponsor after manual testing
options.body: A responsible reviewer may manually validate the same flows on the supported release pair and record the gateway-version compatibility decision.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Split the session grouping and batch-management UI from worktree-aware creation if maintainer review prefers a smaller compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Request focused native proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted macOS recording or terminal/runtime transcript covering group creation or rename, a batch-action partial failure, and worktree session creation against the supported gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged native-chat parity work and this branch place this contributor closest to the shared client/session design.
